the elucidation of the role of VEGF and its receptors in the pathogenesis of breast cancer and the development of novel therapeutic strategies.

VEGF/ VEGFR signalling is an autocrine loop in breast cancer and that this autocrine loop is functional in breast cancer cells.

VEGF/ VEGFR- signalling plays a role in the regulation and maintenance of breast cancer growth and survival.

VEGF signalling is not only important for endothelial cells but is also crucial for cancer cells.
